summary: This maintenance release improves Codex plugin compatibility, configuration evidence, cancellation, and update reliability.
highlights: Use compatible local Codex versions through native plugin discovery and validated Hook registration, without a fixed version allowlist.
Follow configuration changes with content-version evidence. Replayed native AGENTS.md loads count once per document, while different documents remain distinct.
Read queries return CANCELLED when cancellation arrives before the result is delivered. Confirmed preference, directory authorization, price-update, and handoff-send results remain available.
Token budget watch reloads configuration and resumes checks after a concurrent monitor change; invalid arguments still return errors.
Update downloads enforce metadata and archive size limits while streaming, including responses without a reliable Content-Length header. Failed downloads retain the active installation.
Find the installation command and a copyable first question earlier in the README. See task timing, project statistics, budget monitoring, and recurring operations across tasks in one project.
knownLimitations: Codex is the only production data source in this release; support for other agents is planned.
API costs are estimates. Unpriced or partial data stays explicit and is separate from subscription allowance.

Older snapshot or index formats can be rejected without migration. Preserve the original data directory and its user decisions. A different WOMBAT_DATA_HOME creates an isolated store; it does not repair the old store or transfer its decisions.
Timing describes recorded activity and can be partial or provisional. It does not establish why work was slow, code quality, token savings, or model performance.
A sharing summary removes direct identifiers but does not guarantee anonymity. Preview it before sharing.
Large first reads can still take time. Native Codex plugin discovery and Hook registration require a compatible local Codex. Windows Hook collection remains unverified.
